originals.citation: Düzgün, R., Mayer, P., et al. (2022). Shoulder-Surfing Resistant Authentication for Augmented Reality (Things in AR scheme).

quote: This replication study evaluates the recognition-based graphical authentication scheme – Things in AR and VR, extending Düzgün et al. [1], which focused on AR in Germany.
notes: Not @dzgn2022 (the SoK literature review). @noah2023 is this study's own proposal.
